name: sovereign_ocr_extract_bundle
title: 5-Stage Sovereign Document Bundle Extractor
description: Unpack, self-heal, OCR, extract, and ontology-ground a single document file or multi-attachment bundle directory (.pdf, .msg, .eml, .docx, .xlsx, .png, .jpg), emitting a deterministic RDF 1.2 quad_fast provenance receipt and optional SAP S/4HANA BAPI payload.

target_path.description: Absolute path to a document file or bundle directory

entity_code.description: Optional ERP company code / entity code (e.g. '0010')

ontology_json_path.description: Optional path to master ontology JSON file for active runtime grounding

include_sap_bapi.description: Include ready-to-post SAP S/4HANA BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST & OData payload
